title: Opening an application that adds a system tray icon causes the blue highlight line for another pinned system tray widget to be misaligned for a few frames
line: The blue line next to an open system tray popup now stays on its icon when an app adds or removes a tray icon.
explanation: When a tray icon is added, the tray's model first inserts it at the top and then re-sorts it, so the open applet's delegate is pushed down and then re-created in its old place. The highlight only re-positioned itself through Qt.callLater (one frame late) and, since the re-created delegate counted as a different item, it animated into it, so it trailed the icon by several frames. It also never re-read the delegate's position when other items moved. The highlight now follows the delegate's x/y right away, updates as soon as the applet's new delegate is ready, and doesn't animate when the same applet only moved to a new delegate.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: keep the highlight on its icon when items change

When a tray icon appeared or went away, the highlight of the open applet
jumped off its icon for a few frames, since it was only moved afterwards
and even animated into the re-created delegate. Now it follows at once.

BUG: 517561

media.caption: Master, left panel, Clipboard popup pinned: 7 consecutive frames (30 fps) as a tray icon appears. The blue line jumps up away from Clipboard for 4 frames, then sits below it for 1.
Same steps with the fix: the blue line moves together with Clipboard in the same frame.
Master, slowed down 4x: a tray icon appears and disappears; the blue line jumps off Clipboard.
With the fix, slowed down 4x: the blue line stays on Clipboard.
